target.title: feat(ios): add reference-inspired phone shell
target.body: Related: #107804 Stacked on: #107879 ## What Problem This Solves OpenClaw's iPhone surfaces expose gateway activity, chat, voice, and settings, but the first-run and connected experiences do not currently share one clear phone-first hierarchy. Pairing, assistant mode switching, and gateway controls consequently feel like separate products rather than one mobile client. This PR proposes one focused iPhone shell covering the six states in the design reference: splash, pairing, Activity, Assistant Talk, Assistant Chat, and Settings. It does not change protocols, gateway behavior, permissions, dependencies, or the existing iPad presentation. ## Design Credit The visual direction is based on [Vedant Lad (@Vedantdzn), “App redesign for Openclaw”](https://x.com/Vedantdzn/status/2077831186593075637?s=20), posted July 16, 2026. This PR is a native SwiftUI implementation of that public design reference; I do not claim the visual concept as original work. The OpenClaw icon uses the artwork supplied for this implementation. ## Why This Change Was Made - Introduce a coherent branded launch and pairing path. - Present real gateway and agent state through a concise Activity home. - Keep Chat and Talk mounted while switching tabs so assistant state is retained. - Preserve existing reconnect, diagnostics, appearance, and agent-control destinations. - Keep the change phone-only while the stacked unified chat/voice foundation is under review. The Activity screen does not ship screenshot-only task rows. “Recent tasks” opens the existing `BackgroundTasksScreen`, which reads live task history from `NodeAppModel`. QR and manual pairing call the existing onboarding actions, and the production splash is part of the normal iPhone root presentation. ## User Impact - New users get a clearer OpenClaw launch and gateway-pairing experience. - Connected users get consistent Activity, Assistant, and Settings navigation. - Existing Chat, Talk, gateway management, approvals, diagnostics, and settings routes remain functional. - Connected tab surfaces remain mounted instead of being recreated on every tab change. - iPad users retain the existing sidebar experience. ## Evidence ### Production onboarding flow These attachments come from the passing `testReferencePairingAndCompletionOpenChat` UI test. It launches the normal onboarding path without `--openclaw-screenshot-mode`, verifies both pairing actions, uses manual setup, completes the repository's Apple Review demo path, and opens Chat. | Reference pairing wired to production actions | Completed onboarding state | |---|---| | | | ### Six-screen matrix These attachments were exported from the passing `testConnectedGatewayTabs` Xcode result bundle. The test uses the repository's deterministic screenshot launch mode to make the connected visual states repeatable; it is visual regression evidence, not a claim of a live network connection. | Splash | Pairing | Activity | |---|---|---| | | | | | Assistant Talk | Assistant Chat | Settings | | | | | ### Automated verification - `RootTabsSourceGuardTests`, `SwiftUIRenderSmokeTests`, `BackgroundTasksScreenTests`, and the focused branded-typography test: passed. - `OpenClawLogicTests`: 44 tests passed across 7 suites. - `OpenClawSnapshotUITests/testReferencePairingAndCompletionOpenChat`: passed end to end. - `OpenClawSnapshotUITests/testConnectedGatewayTabs`: passed across all six reference states. - Release iOS Simulator build: passed. - Repository-pinned SwiftFormat 0.62.1: 0 of 326 files require formatting. - Repository-pinned SwiftLint 0.65.0 with `--strict --no-cache`: 0 violations in 326 files. - `git diff --check`: passed. - Source regression guards confirm that screenshot-only task copy is absent from production sources and that onboarding forwards the real scan/manual closures. ### Honest limitations - A live external gateway was not available for this local run. The production views consume the existing `NodeAppModel` state, but the screenshots above should not be interpreted as proof of a live gateway round trip. - The PR intentionally remains a draft and stacked on #107879. It should be rebased and the connected-state proof repeated after that parent settles. - The monolithic local `OpenClawTests` runner was not used as the completion signal because unchanged gateway integration cases continuously retry an intentionally unavailable `127.0.0.1:1` endpoint. The scoped native suites, both UI flows, Release build, and repository formatting/lint gates terminate and pass. ## Scope Review This is a single phone-shell proposal rather than a collection of unrelated fixes: the shared shell, the six reference surfaces, onboarding wiring, settings route preservation, visual tests, and regression guards move together. No screenshots are committed to the repository. This contribution was implemented with AI assistance and manually inspected and tested before publication.
